justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/constant/DefaultValue.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/constant/DefaultValueTest.java, and representative callers in byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/StubMethod.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/assign/primitive/VoidAwareAssigner.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/scaffold/TypeWriter.java. The class is a thin enum wrapper: it only delegates to six constant implementations (IntegerConstant, LongConstant, FloatConstant, DoubleConstant, Trivial, NullConstant) and exposes one selector method `of(TypeDefinition)`. Fan-in exists but is modest and localized: `rg` found 10 production callers plus 1 test, mostly bytecode-generation helpers, which is not strong enough to classify it as a dependency hub.
